add.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
add.text: Bobby leads the break-in at the old mansion to free Rogue from Cerebro, then stays behind to hold off the Sentinels so she can escape.
add.whoA: Her ex. Holds off the Sentinels so she can escape.
add.whoB: His ex. He frees her from Cerebro.

add.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
add.text: With Xavier guiding them, Magneto and Bobby break into the old mansion and free Rogue from Cerebro. When Bobby stays behind to hold off the Sentinels, Magneto gets her back to the X-Jet.
add.whoA: Once his captive. Freed by him from Cerebro.
add.whoB: Once her kidnapper. Frees her from her prison in Cerebro.

add.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
add.text: Xavier agrees to rescue Rogue from Cerebro, guides the break-in from the X-Jet and flies her out. At the temple she takes over holding Logan's mind in the past for his plan.
add.whoA: A former student he rescues from Cerebro.
add.whoB: Her old teacher. Leads her rescue from the old mansion.

add.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
add.text: When Kitty weakens, Rogue copies her power and takes over holding Logan's mind in 1973, and in the past he senses the change.
add.whoA: Holds his mind in the past when Kitty can't.
add.whoB: An old friend whose mind she holds in 1973.

add.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
add.text: Betty interviews Ned about Peter for the school news, and grills her ex about late-night texts.
add.whoA: Her ex. Grilled by her about late-night texts.
add.whoB: His ex. Interviews him about Peter.

add.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
add.text: Betty interviews Mr. Harrington about Peter for the school news, and he admits his ex-wife now believes the Mysterio theories.
add.whoA: Betty's teacher, whom she interviews about Peter.
add.whoB: Harrington's student, who interviews him about Peter.

add.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
add.text: Betty interviews Mr. Dell about Peter for the school news, and he tells her what he would be if he were Spider-Man.
add.whoA: Betty's history teacher, whom she interviews about Peter.
add.whoB: Dell's student, who interviews him about Peter.
